20260916_Flamincome.root_cause: Unrestricted external stake actions that artificially skew strategy NAV calculations and vault withdrawal payouts.
20260916_Flamincome.summary: Permissionless staking calls inflated strategy net asset values, causing vaults to overpay during withdrawal operations.
20260916_Flamincome.support_quote: permissionless Convex stakeFor inflates Strategy NAV and lets VaultYUSDT overpay on withdrawAll

20260916_Startale.root_cause: Transient storage initialization flags persisting beyond constructor execution, permitting account re-initialization.
20260916_Startale.summary: An initialization flag stored in transient storage outlived the constructor, allowing unauthorized re-initialization and subsequent draining of ERC7579 accounts.
20260916_Startale.support_quote: transient storage init flag outlives the constructor and lets anyone reinitialize an ERC7579 account and drain it

20260926_DAOstack.root_cause: Inadequate access controls and validation in permissionless organization creation regarding existing Reputation contracts.
20260926_DAOstack.summary: DAOstack allowed permissionless creation of organizations that could hijack existing Reputation contracts and compromise treasury avatars.
20260926_DAOstack.support_quote: permissionless newOrganization lets an attacker hijack an existing Reputation contract and drain the Avatar

20260930_MUS.root_cause: Double-crediting of first-deposit bonuses as both a refund and a withdrawable allocation.
20260930_MUS.summary: MUS deposit logic refunded a first-deposit bonus while simultaneously crediting it as withdrawable allocation, allowing attackers to profit from basic deposit and withdrawal cycles.
20260930_MUS.support_quote: deposit refunds a first-deposit bonus and also credits it as withdrawable allocation, so a single deposit-withdraw from a fresh address returns more ETH than deposited

20261001_FlashLoopAdapter.root_cause: Insecure caller authentication using self-attestation combined with unconstrained external router calls.
20261001_FlashLoopAdapter.summary: A Safe module relied on self-attestation to authenticate callers and made unconstrained calls to external routers, enabling unauthorized actors to drain user Safes that enabled the module.
20261001_FlashLoopAdapter.support_quote: a Safe module authenticates its caller by asking that caller whether the module is enabled (self-attestation) and then makes an unconstrained call to a caller-supplied router

20261008_X7Finance.root_cause: Failure to properly update balance tracking state when processing reward claims with empty token identifiers.
20261008_X7Finance.summary: X7Pioneer added unaccounted ETH balance deltas into total rewards on every claim call without properly refreshing tracking variables, allowing repeated reward claims on donated funds.
20261008_X7Finance.support_quote: X7Pioneer's claimRewards() adds the unaccounted ETH balance delta into totalRewards on every call but only refreshes lastETHBalance when claimable is non-zero

20261015_KolanHook.root_cause: Lack of time-weighted average pricing (TWAP) or price bounds when settling escrowed buy-windows against spot pool prices.
20261015_KolanHook.summary: KolanHook settled escrowed buy-windows using instantaneous spot prices without TWAP bounds, allowing price manipulation via flash loans to misposition escrowed funds as single-sided liquidity and drain window assets.
20261015_KolanHook.support_quote: KolanHook settles its escrowed ETH buy-windows at the same Uniswap v4 pool's instantaneous spot price with no TWAP or bound and accept() is ungated once a window has expired

20261017_BiFi.root_cause: Improper handling of inactive time gaps and interest accumulation calculations during permissionless deposit and borrow surges.
20261017_BiFi.summary: The BiFi USDT market froze its exchange rate and accumulated a large inactive gap, allowing an attacker to manipulate utilization and extract inflated deposit interest through flash borrowing and repeated repay-and-withdraw cycles.
20261017_BiFi.support_quote: the idle BiFi USDT market freezes its per-block exchange rate and stores the entire 264,059-block inactive gap on the first action

dhl_924f5d54541d03c3e24bf649.root_cause: Flawed share accounting where cancel() decremented deposited shares that were already accounted for or left intact during releases.
dhl_924f5d54541d03c3e24bf649.summary: UNCXSmartTokenVesting pooled token deposits globally and suffered from a double-debit vulnerability on share counts during cancellation, enabling attackers to distort denominators and drain backing funds across multiple tokens.
dhl_924f5d54541d03c3e24bf649.support_quote: release() debits that global count but leaves the position's deposited shares in place and cancel() then debits the same shares a second time
